# Map brief: harbor
Status: approved

Built by hand in Studio from this brief, before the toolkit. The place file holds it as
`Workspace.Harbor` with `Layout` and `Dressing` folders.

## Gameplay geometry
- Pier deck 12 studs wide, 1 stud above the water.
- Dock lanes at least 8 studs wide.

## Check views
- Pier from the spawn, looking along the docks.
